novelty_flags.label: prop:single-positive-layer-reduction
novelty_flags.one_line: This is an algebraic specialization of Possebom--Riva arXiv v6 Proposition 2, so it should be retained only as a cited sanity corollary, not an independently novelty-bearing solve target.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: ass:positive-stayer-floor
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The observable lower bound on forced positive-layer stayer mass is maintained rather than derived from randomization and ordered selection.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The prism and sharp endpoint claims are conditional on the observable separated domain D_{L,kappa}; this is a legitimate denominator-stability regime restriction, not an assumed contribution.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 23--25, discussion immediately following Theorem 1(iii) and Remark 2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1(iii) gives sharp closed-form bounds for a weighted average of LCDEs and explicitly notes that its aggregate problem optimizes jointly over response-type probabilities.
Theorem 2 gives a sharp interval for binary fraction negatively affected, derived by conditional Fréchet--Hoeffding bounds from observed factual-law marginals.
Proposition 2 gives sharp conditional probability-of-causation bounds for the always-observed subgroup under random assignment, positive mass, and monotone sample selection.
